source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-18

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Muncie 4-speed): remove, overhaul and install
steps: Installation: move the 1-2 lever to second (forward) and lay the gasket on the case.
Set the cover in place with each fork engaged in its mainshaft sliding sleeve (see figure 21 in the manual).
Install the cover bolts and tighten them evenly.
Remove the filler plug and fill with the Section 0 lubricant to the bottom of the filler hole.

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Saginaw 4-speed): remove, overhaul and install
steps: Removal: unhook the control rods from the levers.
Put the transmission in the neutral detents before removing the cover.
Lift the cover off carefully and let it drain.
Disassembly: remove the outer shifter levers.
Take both forks off their shafts, then pull all three shifter shafts from the cover; pry out the O-rings only if damaged. Remove the reverse shaft detent ball and spring.
Remove the detent cam spring and pivot C-ring; mark the detent cams for reassembly and remove them.
Replace damaged parts.
Assembly: with the spring tang sticking up over the 3-4 shaft opening, put the 1-2 detent cam on the pivot pin; with the tang up over the 1-2 shaft hole, fit the 3-4 cam.
Fit the C-ring on the pivot shaft and hook the spring into the cam notches.
Insert the 1-2 and 3-4 shafts without harming the seals; fit both forks, lifting the detent cam so they seat fully.
Fit the reverse detent ball and spring, then the reverse shifter shaft.
Fit the outer levers with flat washers, lock washers and bolts.
Installation: put the levers in the center (neutral) detent and lay the gasket on the case.
Set the cover in place with each fork engaged in its mainshaft sliding sleeve.
Install the cover bolts and tighten evenly to specified torque.
Remove the filler plug and fill with the Section 0 lubricant to the bottom of the filler hole.
notes: The 1-2 detent cam has .090" more contour at the inner detent notch than the 3-4 cam.
See figure 22 in the manual for the cover parts.
